newsitem.title: USA: Marquette to swap chairman's Class C shrs.
newsitem.headline: Marquette to swap chairman's Class C shrs.

text.p: Marquette Medical Systems Inc said Monday it agreed to exchange no more than 525,000 class A common shares for the 26,250,000 class C shares held by its chairman, Michael Cudahy.
Marquette said the number of shares to be transferred to Cudahy will be determined by the board of directors, based upon the recommendation of its outside financial advisor.
Cudahy holds all the class C shares.
The exchange will leave Marquette with a single class of stock outstanding. The consummation of the exchange will be accompanied by the adoption of a shareholder rights plan, the company said.

"The initial intent of the C shares is no longer compatible with the growth plans we have for Marquette,' Cudahy said in a statement. "The exchange leaves us with only one class of stock, which simplifies our capital structure."
A spokesman said both the class A and C shares each carried one vote. By exchanging Cudahy's 26.25 million class C shares for up to 525,000 class A shares, his voting rights will be reduced.

"In giving up the C shares, I want our shareholders to know that I have confidence in the management team that has orchestrated our growth and do not want a complicated equity structure to affect shareholder value," Cudahy said.
Marquette makes electronic medical equipment and systems.
